Show where a project's files are and how it starts.

--size adds the disk space of the project itself (its folder, settings, allowlist and batch jobs), and of its env and workspace folders when they are kept elsewhere. It reads every file, which can take a while.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower projects show PROJECT [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size` |  | also show the disk space of the project and of its env and workspace folders (slow for large projects) |

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--env-dir string` |  | folder of the projects' env folders, for projects whose settings do not name one (or env_dir in the config) |
| `--projects-dir string` |  | folder of the projects started with --project (or projects_dir in the config; default ~/codeflower/projects) |
